title: Vault: chaos process-kill a standby (cluster self-heals to green)
description: Runs `nexus chaos vault process-kill --duration 10 --yes`. SIGKILLs a STANDBY vault.service (never the active node), holds for the duration, then confirms the cluster recovers to green.

observe.what: SIGKILL on a STANDBY vault.service (never the active); after ~10s the standby is back and the cluster recovers to green

whatProves: VaultAdapter chaos process-kill deliberately targets a STANDBY vault.service (preserving the active leader), then verifies the cluster self-heals back to green once the killed standby restarts and re-unseals.
